resources.string: This app is designed with privacy in mind. All your collection data, including your API keys and game library, is stored locally on your device in an encrypted or private database. No data is ever sent to our servers, as we don\'t have any. The app only communicates with external services (like IGDB, Steam, etc.) using the API keys you provide, and only to fetch game information or sync your owned games. For more information, you can inspect the open-source code on GitHub.
Your collection is empty. Tap + to add games!
Search for a game to add it to your collection.
Welcome to your PC Game Collection
To search for games, you need to provide your IGDB API credentials (from Twitch Developer Portal).

1. Go to the Twitch Developer Portal (https://dev.twitch.tv/console).
2. Log in with your Twitch account.
3. Register a new application (e.g., "PC Game Collection").
4. Set the OAuth Redirect URL to "http://localhost".
5. Category: "Application Integration".
6. Once created, you will see your Client ID.
7. Click "New Secret" to generate your Client Secret. **Keep it safe!**
Please enter both Client ID and Client Secret
Invalid credentials. Please check your Client ID and Secret.
